headline: The "10 of 10 devx tables unmanaged by CloudFormation" fact is FALSE - all 11 are CFN-managed as GlobalTable; preflight.py:366 is a one-line false positive
The P-28 replacement gate cannot protect any table here - changeset_replacement_report.py protects AWS::DynamoDB::Table, every table is AWS::DynamoDB::GlobalTable
cdk diff CareerVpCrudDevx is clean: zero stateful changes; handoff 03 B11 blocker does not exist
All four committed fixes have tests that genuinely fail without the fix (4 of 4 RED)
Log retention is 1 day on 31 of 32 devx Lambdas, not just gap-api
The purchase path is mock end to end: PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock, placeholder price IDs, no Stripe key, 43 tautological assertions

incidental_findings.detail: tests/integration/test_l2_auth_integration.py and test_l1_phase_integration.py rewrite tracked docs/beta/evidence/*.json (timestamp only); npm run typecheck rewrites the committed build artifact src/frontend/dist/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
incidental_findings.finding: Running the mandatory checks dirties the tree, so an admissible (git_dirty: false) proof cannot be recorded after them

combined.recommendation: Do not re-ground the plan - 81% is above the ~70% bar and all 12 test-estate predictions held exactly. But every miss is in the deploy-safety layer, and two of them share one root cause: the AWS::DynamoDB::GlobalTable vs ::Table type name defeats both preflight.py:366 and changeset_replacement_report.py, producing one false alarm and one silent hole. Add a fourth W0 item - fix both type-name blind spots - and land it before handoff 03 step 4, whose entire safety argument rests on a gate that cannot currently fire.

A.command: aws cloudformation list-stack-resources (root + 5 nested); grep AWS::DynamoDB infra/cdk.out/CareerVpCrudDevx.template.json

C.claim: which make deploy workflows actually deploy vs no-op
C.command: read each workflow; gh api repos/:owner/:repo/environments
C.detail: 6 of 10 reach a real deploy; 5 of those auto-deploy on a branch push with no human gate. The dev GitHub environment has protection_rules: [] and deployment_branch_policy: null, so environment: dev is not a gate.
